name: Load Agent Context
description: Keep something visible in your context across turns until you remove it: a lattice path loaded now, a note you write (text), a read-only operation whose result you want watched (op), or a finished job's result (job). Give exactly one of path, text, op or job; text, op and job also need an id — the key shown in the element's header and passed to context_unload. Use for rules, schemas or reference material you consult repeatedly; for data needed once, use an advertised inspection or read operation instead. An op entry is checked before every model call and appends a new observation only when its rendered result changes; other entries render once. Scoped to this conversation (subgoals inherit it); other conversations are unaffected.

path.description: Lattice path to keep visible (e.g. w/docs/rules, n/notes). Its own key.

id.description: Key for a text, op or job entry — used as a key in the loaded_context result map

text.description: A note to keep in context, verbatim

op.description: A read-only operation path (e.g. v/ops/covia/list) checked before every model call; a new result is appended only when it changes

job.description: A completed job's id; its output is the content

budget.description: Byte budget for rendering a structured value (default 500, max 10000); a hard cap on a volatile entry whatever its shape

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this context entry

volatile.description: Watch before each model call and append a new observation only when the rendered value changes. Default true for op, else false. Set true for a path likely to change during this conversation; leave false for stable reference material.
